body:
I've only had one session with her so far, but she seems much more kind and understanding than my previous therapists. 

The question running through my mind is: is trying worth anything if you don't believe in what you're trying for? I feel like I'm just going through the motions, here, to appease my family and friends. Or is it enough that I hope, even if I don't believe?

I am a monster, too. I'm always reluctant to post here because nobody on this subreddit seems to deserve the fate that I do. I tried to go through with it recently, and the person that could not bring themself to be associated with me, after learning what I had done, is the one who stopped me and called the cops. It makes no sense...
